DWF-9475.summary: FM note ran; remaining fm_approve_complete flow interrupted; later recovered; task complete — no further work
DWF-9475.checklistSummary: FM note ran; remaining fm_approve_complete flow interrupted; later recovered; task complete — no further work
DWF-9475.jiraSummary: FM Approved but SLC was still in FM Approval step - mi60ms3pybhz
DWF-9475.ourStatusText: Done — no further work required; task already corrected and completed
whatWasDone: Debugged prod task mi60ms3pybhz (tasks.json + notes.json)
Compared fm_approve_complete / fm_approve_complete_final in 03-FmApproval.lua against notes and approval logs
Confirmed current task state: workflow_id = complete_final, task_status = 900 (closed/completed)
findings: When greg.mulholland@bgis.com approved FM the first time (Confirm Complete), TaskNote in fm_approve_complete ran successfully. Note at 2025-11-24T11:28:13.847-05:00 — route had started.

Remaining lines in that flow did not complete (log update / Finance insert / message / redirect to fm_approve_complete_final where TaskUpdateWorkflow(finance_approval) runs). Likely user left/closed the page before finish.
Result: FM approval note existed, but task did not move to Finance Approval on first attempt.
Later ~2025-11-28T15:01:48–15:01:50 the task was corrected into Finance Approval (FM status_change_date + Finance email_sent_date).
Audit history does not show who fixed the task or how.
Root cause: incomplete page/route execution after Confirm Complete — not a workflow/config defect.
DWF-9475.imgCaption: Green: TaskNote executed (Nov 24) and later recovery / completed state. Red: remaining fm_approve_complete workflow/log lines did not run on first attempt.
DWF-9475.footnote: Route reference: 03-FmApproval.lua — fm_approve_complete (TaskNote + logs + RedirectReload) → fm_approve_complete_final (TaskUpdateWorkflow finance_approval). Conclusion: no further work required.
